title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Client

Our client is a global technology company specialized in large-scale cloud infrastructure, automation of distributed systems, and deep integration between hardware and software.

The engineering environment is highly technical, fast-paced, and built around autonomy, ownership, and solving complex infrastructure challenges at global scale.


About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Infrastructure Engineer with a strong software engineering background and solid experience in automating complex infrastructure environments.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

This is a high-impact, product-focused role , responsible for building tools, automation layers, APIs, and workflows that will be directly consumed by the company’s customers — not only internal teams.

This is not a traditional DevOps/Platform position focused on provisioning resources internally.

Here, you will be designing and engineering infrastructure automation as product , interacting with hardware, clusters, and low-level systems that power a global cloud offering.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop tools, automations, APIs, and infrastructure workflows used directly by end customers.
  • Build automation layers that interact with physical hardware and low-level components (state management, provisioning logic, control sequences, etc.).
  • Create and maintain internal backends and integrations linking services, infrastructure, and the core platform.
  • Leverage programming languages — especially Python — to design robust and scalable automation solutions.
  • Work on the automation behind global infrastructure and distributed clusters.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement within the platform and proactively propose solutions.


Technical Requirements

  • Senior-level experience in software development , especially with Python.
  • Strong background in infrastructure automation and distributed environments.
  • Experience working with hardware , data centers, bare-metal environments, or infrastructure-heavy companies.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, internal workflows, provisioning automation, and backend integrations.
  • Ability to work in low-level contexts involving hardware components and state management.
  • Proven experience building solutions from scratch , not only executing predefined tasks.


Cultural & Behavioral Profile

  • High autonomy: must be able to discover opportunities, define approaches, and drive solutions independently.
  • Seniority and maturity to operate within a team of highly experienced engineers.
  • Hands-on, proactive mindset, with strong ownership and problem-solving orientation.
  • Experience in fast-paced environments (startups or mixed small/large company backgrounds).
  • Curiosity and flexibility to learn new technologies and navigate cross-disciplinary areas.


English Requirement

  • Advanced English is mandatory , as the leadership and part of the engineering team are international.


What Will Not Fit

  • Junior or mid-level professionals.
  • Candidates who only worked in slow, highly structured corporate environments.
  • Profiles focused solely on execution or maintenance (not creation).
  • Professionals who depend heavily on direction and lack technical autonomy.


Contract Model

  • PJ / Contractor (LLC) — engagement through independent contractor arrangement.
  • The candidate must be legally able to invoice through a company (LLC or equivalent).


Work Model

  • Remote (remote-friendly).
  • The company has no restrictions regarding location, as long as the candidate meets performance expectations and availability for team collaboration.


Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on the core product , not just internal tooling.
  • Unique combination of software + hardware + global infrastructure engineering .
  • High autonomy and opportunity to design new components from scratch.
  • Collaboration with a senior, highly technical engineering team.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software
description:
POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO

A Onze é uma das nossas start-ups e está reinventando a Previdência Privada. Somos a primeira PrevTech do Brasil, trazendo uma proposta totalmente digital para um mercado tradicionalmente analógico. Acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação podem ter impacto real na maneira com que as pessoas se preparam financeiramente para o futuro. Além de uma empresa de tecnologia, somos também uma gestora de investimentos, com fundos de previdência privada eficientes e desenhados para trazer o melhor retorno com o menor custo possível – como a Previdência deve ser. Nossos fundos, plataforma tecnológica e soluções de saúde financeira tem como objetivo maximizar a acumulação eficiente de patrimônio, um dos maiores desafios do povo Brasileiro.


O TIME

O time da Onze é distribuído em pequenos times ágeis que valorizam a cultura onde cada pessoa desenvolvedora tem autonomia para participar de todo o processo de desenvolvimento, inclusive as etapas de concepção de ideias. Priorizamos e incentivamos que as pessoas se desenvolvam tanto tecnicamente como em outras áreas de competência como comunicação e liderança. Temos orgulho de trabalhar na primeira fintech em previdência privada do Brasil e temos a inovação tecnológica e criatividade como uma das bases do nosso dia a dia.


A OPORTUNIDADE

Você irá participar diretamente das etapas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes automatizados, code review e deploy de funcionalidades em sistemas na nuvem. Você vai trabalhar com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta em aplicações que demandam alta disponibilidade, baixa latência e escalabilidade em um ambiente de desenvolvimento que prioriza eficiência, testes, qualidade e alta entrega de valor.


O QUE PROCURAMOS

  • Pessoas das áreas de Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas que sejam proativas e apaixonadas por tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação. Ex: Go, Java, Python, C# (gostamos bastante de Go, se não souber, você pode aprender aqui!);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc);
  • Experiência em computação em nuvem (de preferência AWS);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de solução;
  • Valorizar qualidade e código limpo;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados;
  • Interesse em desenvolver soft skills como comunicação e liderança;
  • Inglês intermediário/Avançado


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Acompanhamento e gestão de carreira com ciclos de avaliação semestrais estruturados e feedbacks recorrentes;
  • Planos de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde para Pet;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Plano de saúde financeira incluindo consultorias individualizadas com profissionais certificados;
  • Benefício refeição/flexível da Swile;
  • Incentivo educacional anual em formato de reembolso;
  • Acesso à plataforma da Udemy;
  • Bônus anual de acordo com a performance;
  • Voucher ifood no mês de aniversário;
  • Gympass/Totalpass;
  • Empresa cidadã
  • Modelo CLT - remoto;

description:
Vaga: Gestor de Projetos Sênior Marketing & Operação de Influenciadores de Alto Nível

Modelo de contrato: PJ

Horário: 9h às 18h (focado em entrega e performance)

Local: 100% Home Office

Salário: R$ 4.000,00/mês inicial → após 2 meses de entrega real vai para R$ 6.000,00/mês

Sobre a Empresa

Somos uma operação cristã, conservadora, disciplinada e extremamente profissional .

Atendemos influenciadores gigantes , com milhões de seguidores, e operamos um ecossistema robusto com múltiplas contas, proxies, fluxos de demanda, gerenciamento de conexão e alta complexidade operacional .

Aqui, a cultura é direta:

  • Zero mimimi
  • Alta performance
  • Estrutura horizontal , baseada em autonomia, responsabilidade e entrega real
  • Meritocracia e crescimento rápido para quem faz acontecer

Se você não consegue trabalhar sob pressão, gerenciar caos organizado e liderar pessoas com firmeza — não é pra você .

Requisitos (Eliminatórios)

Buscamos O CARA — alguém com experiência comprovada e maturidade profissional.

É obrigatório ter:

✔ Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes grandes

✔ Experiência com clientes de grande porte e influenciadores

✔ Experiência avançada em gestão de projetos complexos

✔ Experiência com marketing digital

✔ Vivência prática com proxies, multilogin, estrutura de contas, acessos e conexões

✔ Capacidade de liberar e organizar demandas de alta complexidade

✔ Experiência em criar atas de reunião, organização de projetos e cronogramas

✔ Comunicação assertiva, postura firme e capacidade de tomada de decisão

✔ Experiência com CRM e organização via Google Sheets/Excel

✔ Perfil extremamente organizado, disciplinado e orientado a resultados

Se não tiver todos esses pontos, não se candidate .

Responsabilidades Principais

Você vai comandar a operação e garantir que tudo funcione com precisão:

  • Gerenciar influenciadores de grande porte e suas demandas diárias
  • Coordenar equipes internas e acompanhar cada etapa operacional
  • Garantir entregas, prazos, metas e organização da operação
  • Criar atas, cronogramas, planejamentos e relatórios
  • Realizar onboarding de novos clientes e liderar reuniões estratégicas
  • Monitorar KPIs, interpretar dados e reportar resultados
  • Acompanhar liberação e execução de demandas em larga escala
  • Gerenciar acessos, contas, proxies e conexões dentro dos padrões internos
  • Antecipar problemas e apresentar soluções rápidas e práticas
VRemuneração
  • R$ 4.000,00/mês (inicial)
  • R$ 6.000,00/mês após 2 meses de performance comprovada
  • Crescimento rápido para quem entrega acima da média
  • Possibilidade real de assumir posições maiores e até participação futura
Diferenciais (Não Eliminatórios)
  • Experiência em ambientes de alta pressão
  • Vivência em negociações de alta performance
  • Experiência prévia com influenciadores grandes
  • Capacidade de assumir novos projetos rapidamente
O Que Oferecemos
  • Ambiente extremamente profissional, conservador e focado em disciplina
  • Liberdade com responsabilidade (entrega acima de tudo)
  • Cultura de meritocracia real
  • Oportunidade de crescimento acelerado
  • Possibilidade futura de sociedade para os mais excepcionais

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

title: Java Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Java Developer to join our international team. We deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and distributed development teams.


About the Role:


As a Java Developer , you will work on the design, development, and maintenance of Java-based applications that support key business functions. A strong command of Java 8 and hands-on experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) are essential for this role, as you will be deeply involved in log validation, performance optimization, and application stability.

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges across multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Java 8 applications using Spring Framework (Spring 4.1.3 and Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Lead and participate in application migration projects , with a focus on optimizing and validating logs in ELK .
  • Implement and fine-tune Elasticsearch indexing, querying, and data retrieval for high-performance applications.
  • Maintain and enhance front-end components using JSP, jQuery, and AngularJS .
  • Configure and deploy applications on Tomcat servers , ensuring reliability outside OpenShift environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage approximately 40 applications , maintaining stability and version consistency.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps templates for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated smoke tests for proactive issue detection.


Required Qualifications:


  • Expert-level experience with Java 8 and Spring Frameworks (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Proven expertise working with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, validation, and performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and automated testing frameworks .
  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology , or related field (or equivalent experience).


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development , Computer Science , or Computer Engineering .
  • Additional experience in client-facing roles or international projects.

This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and distributed development teams.


About the Role:


As a Java Developer , you will work on the design, development, and maintenance of Java-based applications that support key business functions. A strong command of Java 8 and hands-on experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) are essential for this role, as you will be deeply involved in log validation, performance optimization, and application stability.

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges across multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Java 8 applications using Spring Framework (Spring 4.1.3 and Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Lead and participate in application migration projects , with a focus on optimizing and validating logs in ELK .
  • Implement and fine-tune Elasticsearch indexing, querying, and data retrieval for high-performance applications.
  • Maintain and enhance front-end components using JSP, jQuery, and AngularJS .
  • Configure and deploy applications on Tomcat servers , ensuring reliability outside OpenShift environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage approximately 40 applications , maintaining stability and version consistency.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps templates for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated smoke tests for proactive issue detection.


Required Qualifications:


  • Expert-level experience with Java 8 and Spring Frameworks (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Proven expertise working with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, validation, and performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and automated testing frameworks .
  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology , or related field (or equivalent experience).


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development , Computer Science , or Computer Engineering .
  • Additional experience in client-facing roles or international projects.

title: Product Manager (PM) Pleno
description:
Modalidade: Presencial – Brasília

Regime: CLT

Carga horária: Segunda à sexta - 8h às 18h


Responsabilidades:

  • Conduzir o discovery de produto (problema, hipótese, validação com usuários e viabilidade técnica). Transformar oportunidades em requisitos claros (user stories e critérios de aceitação).
  • Gerir o backlog e facilitar cerimônias ágeis (planning, refinement, review).
  • Construir, manter e comunicar o Roadmap (visão 6–12 meses), incluindo: Priorizações por impacto/esforço e alinhamento com objetivos do negócio;
  • Planejamento trimestral (OKRs / metas), gestão de dependências entre squads/sistemas;
  • Release planning, janelas de deploy, riscos e mitigação;
  • Atualizações recorrentes para stakeholders (versão executiva e versão técnica).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Design, Dev e QA para garantir qualidade, prazo e valor entregue.
  • Acompanhar o pós-lançamento (feedback qualitativo, adoção e próximos incrementos).
  • Ser a ponte entre áreas de negócio e time técnico, garantindo contexto e priorização.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Manager ou Product Owner em produtos digitais.
  • Domínio de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Habilidade de escrever user stories e critérios de aceitação objetivos.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e priorização.
  • Noções de arquitetura, integrações e APIs para dialogar com o time técnico.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em marketplaces, e-commerces, plataformas de eventos ou infoprodutos.
  • Experiência com cashless e meios de pagamento.
  • Experiência em empresas SaaS.
  • Uso de IA aplicada à gestão e automação de rotinas de produto.
  • Conhecimento em ClickUp, Jira, Figma ou Notion.
  • Entregáveis esperados do PM Roadmap (6–12 meses) com critérios de priorização e dependências mapeadas.
  • Plano trimestral (OKRs/Metas) e visão por releases. PRDs / Especificações com user stories e critérios de aceitação. Notas de versão e checklist de go-live.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas relacionados ao nosso produto de vale-transporte. A pessoa ideal deve ter boa capacidade técnica, proatividade e vontade de aprender e evoluir em um ambiente colaborativo.


Responsabilidades


· Desenvolver funcionalidades em sistemas legados e novos microsserviços.

· Participar de integrações via APIs REST e SOAP.

· Colaborar com o time na resolução de problemas técnicos e melhorias contínuas.

· Escrever testes unitários e seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

· Participar das cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com ideias e soluções.


Requisitos Técnicos


· Java (8 ou superior), SpringBoot, Hibernate JPA.

· JSP, JSF, STRUTS (legado).

· Angular, Bootstrap, TypeScript, JavaScript.

· PL/SQL, Oracle.

· GIT, Maven ou Gradle.

· Conhecimento básico em containers e mensageria.

· Metodologias ágeis (Scrum).

· Testes com JUnit.


Diferenciais


· Experiência prévia com produtos de financeiros, mobilidade urbana ou benefícios corporativos (vale-transporte).

· Experiência com microsserviços e API Gateway (Sensedia).

· Conhecimento em MongoDB e Azure.

· Interesse em atuar com modernização de sistemas.

title: SAP Opentext
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!


Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.


Procuramos SAP-BASIS/OpenText/ SFSF HCM Extended ECM ,Brazil que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Nesta função você irá: (responsabilidades)

Responsabilidades:


Atuar na implantação e sustentação de soluções OpenText Content Server e Extended ECM integradas ao SAP (xECM for Finance e xECM for SuccessFactors);


Realizar levantamento de requisitos, configurações, parametrizações, testes e suporte técnico-funcional;


Participar de projetos de integração e evolução das soluções OpenText, com foco em conformidade, gestão documental e governança de informação;


Elaborar documentação técnica/funcional e realizar treinamentos para usuários-chave;


Apoiar na gestão de performance da plataforma e propor melhorias contínuas.



✅ Requisitos obrigatórios:


Experiência sólida com soluções OpenText, principalmente:

Extended ECM for SAP SuccessFactors e Finanças.


Atuação comprovada em projetos de implantação e sustentação;

Conhecimento técnico-funcional e visão de negócios;

Certificações desejáveis:

5-0158 – OpenText Content Server Business User Certification Exam

5-0159 – OpenText Content Server Business Administrator Certification Exam


Certificação obrigatória:

5-2052 – Extended ECM for SAP SuccessFactors Business Administrator Certification Exam


O que você pode esperar de nós?

Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.

Oportunidades para trabalho fora do Brasil

Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

Benefícios TCS – Brasil:

Plano de Saúde

Plano Odontológico

Seguro de Vida

Vale Transporte

Vale Refeição/Alimentação

Auxílio Creche

Gympass

TCS Cares – 0800 gratuito que fornece assistência psicológica (24 hrs/dia), jurídica, social e financeira aos associados

Parceria com SESC

Portal de aprendizagem gratuito da TCS – cursos online e treinamentos ao vivo

Oportunidade de experiência internacional

Parceria de Descontos com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas

Bring Your Buddy – Ao indicar pessoas você se torna elegível a receber um bônus para cada contratação

TCS Gems – Reconhecimento por performance

Xcelerate – Plataforma de carreira com mentoria gratuita


Na TATA Consultancy Services promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, trabalhamos sempre pela equidade. Isso se aplica em Gênero, Pessoas com Deficiência, LGBTQIA+, Religião, Raça, Etnia, ou seja, todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com esses princípios. Pensamos em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social, a fim de construir uma TCS que respeita a individualidade. Seja um TCSer!

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Linguistics Expert
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the role:


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented linguist to support AI training initiatives and linguistic content creation. This role is ideal for someone with a strong academic background in linguistics (syntax, semantics, pragmatics, morphology, phonology, sociolinguistics, etc.) and a passion for language, technology, and clear communication. You will play a crucial role in shaping the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and NLP-based systems through high-quality linguistic data curation, annotation, and evaluation.


Job Title: Linguistics Expert – AI Training & Content Writing



Key Responsibilities:


  • Create or edit linguistically- rich content including grammar guides, syntactic analyses, usage explanations, or examples for NLP pipelines.
  • Identify and resolve issues related to ambiguity, bias, and grammaticality.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) on model outputs for fluency, tone, factual accuracy, and language appropriateness.
  • Annotate linguistic datasets with syntactic, semantic, or pragmatic labels.
  • Support internal teams by conducting linguistic research and summarizing findings.
  • Apply linguistic knowledge to evaluate model behavior, error patterns, and generalization issues.


Qualifications:

  • Deep understanding of linguistic theory and language structure.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: computational linguistics, corpus analysis, language data annotation, LLM training.
  • Strong writing, editing, and communication skills.


Next Steps

To proceed further in the evaluation process, you will need to complete two assessments:

  • Assessment Test
  • Evaluates your linguistic and analytical skills
  • Link:



  • Versant English Proficiency Test
  • Focuses on assessing your spoken and written English proficiency
  • A C1 or C2 level is required to qualify


Once both assessments are successfully completed, you will be eligible for onboarding.

  • Language test


Action Required: XConnect Registration

You will also receive an invitation to our internal job platform, XConnect . Please take a few minutes to register and complete your profile. All project onboarding, communication, and documentation are managed through this platform.


If interested, kindly share your resume at:

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner plays a key role in driving hiring success across Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams in the LATAM region. This role operates within client’s global Talent Acquisition organization and partners closely with business leaders to develop and execute effective hiring strategies.


It requires a high level of autonomy, strong stakeholder management, and a consultative approach to ensure high-quality, timely hires in a competitive market. The Senior Talent Acquisition Partner helps shape hiring plans, advise on talent trends, and champion client’s growth across LATAM.


Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Manage full-cycle recruitment across Engineering, Product, and GTM roles in the LATAM region — from intake through offer.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and senior leaders to define needs, build strategies, and drive hiring outcomes.
  • Use tools like LinkedIn Recruiter to proactively source top talent and build diverse pipelines.
  • Translate market research into actionable hiring strategies, including competitor insights, compensation trends, and talent availability.
  • Own the candidate experience, ensuring timely communication, smooth process flow, and alignment with client’s brand.
  • Leverage AI tools and recruiting technology to enhance speed, quality, and efficiency throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including interview process design, DEI initiatives, and talent analytics.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5–10 years of professional experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally across technical and go-to-market roles.
  • Proven success recruiting in the LATAM region, with a strong understanding of local talent markets.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish; able to communicate effectively across diverse stakeholders.
  • Skilled in sourcing and candidate engagement using tools like LinkedIn Recruiter.
  • Comfortable working independently and managing multiple roles with competing priorities.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders on hiring decisions, market insights, and strategy.
  • Proficiency with applicant tracking systems; Workday experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI tools and technology into recruiting workflows.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Portuguese language proficiency.
  • Prior recruiting experience within SaaS or high-growth product companies.
  • Familiarity with Workday or similar enterprise-level ATS platforms.

title: Analista de Pré-Vendas (SDR)
description:
Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?

Somos a Doctoralia , empresa do grupo Docplanner , e estamos presentes em 13 países , sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!

Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.

Nossa missão é "Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis"


Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos : marketplace , que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online . Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android .


Job Description


  • Prospectar ativamente potenciais clientes via telefone , e-mail, WhatsApp e redes sociais, utilizando estratégias de cold calling e cadências outbound.
  • Gerar interesse nos potenciais clientes, fazendo uma abordagem consultiva para entender suas necessidades e como nossas soluções podem ajudá-los.
  • Qualificar os leads , analisando criticamente se há fit com nossas soluções antes de direcioná-los ao Executivo de Vendas.
  • Manter um pipeline organizado no CRM (Salesforce) e em planilhas internas, garantindo o registro detalhado de cada contato.
  • Executar sequências de contato (automatizadas e personalizadas) de forma consistente para maximizar o engajamento com os prospects.
  • Fazer follow-up constante com os leads, respeitando a cadência definida para cada etapa do funil.
  • Acompanhar métricas e indicadores , propondo otimizações no processo de prospecção e buscando constantemente a melhoria dos resultados.


Qualifications


  • Experiência prévia com prospecção Outbound (SDR ou Pré-vendas), incluindo cold calling.
  • Conhecimento de CRM (Salesforce é um diferencial) e ferramentas de automação de vendas.
  • Foco em resultados , com ambição e motivação para bater metas agressivas.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, essencial para criar rapport e transmitir valor rapidamente.
  • Organização e senso de urgência , importantes para gerenciar diversos leads simultaneamente e não perder oportunidades.
  • Proatividade, resiliência e persuasão , habilidades-chave para contornar objeções e manter ritmo constante de prospecção.
  • Interesse em construir carreira na área de vendas e prospecção de novos negócios, buscando crescimento e aprendizado constante.


Modelo de Trabalho

  • Híbrido para profissionais localizados no Rio de Janeiro.
  • Fornecemos o material necessário, mas, é fundamental ter um local adequado e acesso estável à internet.
  • Remoto para todo o Brasil


Additional information


Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.

  • Jornada de trabalho é de segunda à sexta, das 9h às 18h;
  • Banco de horas como folga, posteriormente;
  • Auxílio HomeOffice;
  • Vale-Refeição , pode substituí-lo pelo Vale-Alimentação ou, ainda, pedir meio a meio, no mesmo valor;
  • Assistência Médica, Odontológica e Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • StarBem, para saúde mental e bem-estar;
  • App iFeel, para apoio emocional;
  • Gympass para você e mais 3 dependentes!
  • Plano Pet estendendo o cuidado, também, para o seu animalzinho;
  • Benefícios Creditas : rede de empréstimo consignado;
  • Stock Options - elegível após 6 meses de casa;
  • Day Off de Aniversário , para que comemore do jeito que preferir;
  • Clube de Parcerias , com convênios e descontos com instituições de ensino, como faculdades e idiomas;
  • Licenças diferenciadas : em caso de falecimento de pessoas amadas, oferecemos 10 dias; caso seu Pet venha a óbito, tem 2 dias. Casou? 7 dias de descanso! O bebê chegou? Oferecemos 30 dias para o papai e 6 meses para a mamãe;
  • Programa de Indicação oferece até R$600 por indicação que permaneça conosco por mais de 6 meses.

title: Lead AI Engineer
description:
Lead AI Engineer (3 Positions)

Location: Brazil (Remote / Hybrid based on project needs)


Role Overview

We are seeking highly skilled Lead AI Engineers based in Brazil to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI and machine learning solutions across enterprise systems. The ideal candidates will have strong expertise in Generative AI , RAG architectures , LLMs , and hands-on experience with the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) AI ecosystem.

You will lead AI engineering initiatives, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive innovation in intelligent automation, personalization, and data-driven decision-making.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and development of scalable ML models , Generative AI , and RAG-based solutions.
  • Build end-to-end AI/ML pipelines using GCP tools: Vertex AI , Gemini , Vector Search , and Managed Notebooks.
  • Develop intelligent agents and orchestration using LangChain , LangGraph , Google ADK , and CrewAI .
  • Build, fine-tune, and deploy custom LLMs and multimodal AI models.
  • Own technical architecture, solution design, performance optimization, and deployment strategies.
  • Partner with data engineers, cloud teams, and product stakeholders to integrate AI at scale.
  • Implement MLOps best practices for versioning, monitoring, retraining, and governance.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to AI engineering standards and frameworks.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering , including leadership responsibilities.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Generative AI and RAG pipelines .
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Deep expertise in the GCP AI/ML stack , including:
  • Vertex AI
  • Gemini
  • Vector Search
  • AI Studio / AI APIs
  • Strong experience with agent-oriented frameworks :
  • LangChain
  • LangGraph
  • CrewAI
  • Google ADK
  • Experience deploying ML models into production using CI/CD and MLOps .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data engineering fundamentals, cloud-native deployment, and microservices.
  • Excellent communication and ability to lead technical discussions with global teams.


Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with multi-agent systems and advanced tool orchestration.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes , Docker , and cloud-native architectures.
  • Understanding of AI security, compliance, and responsible AI frameworks.
  • Experience working in global, distributed engineering teams.


Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.

title: Creative Content & Concept Specialist - 51437
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking a Creative Content & Concept Specialist with a background in film, video production, or screenplay writing to develop short-form video concepts and narrative structures. This role requires strong storytelling ability, visual thinking, and the skill to translate creative ideas into clear, structured briefs suitable for production and content development workflows.


Day-to-day responsibilities:

Develop short-form video concepts , creative storylines, and scene breakdowns across genres such as drama, comedy, lifestyle, and commercial content.

  • Write clear, production-ready descriptions of scenes, including character actions, camera framing, and sound or environmental cues.
  • Create structured documentation of concepts, ensuring clarity, visual coherence, and emotional consistency.
  • Collaborate with internal creative, production, and quality teams to refine ideas and maintain alignment with content guidelines.
  • Ensure accuracy, continuity, and realism in narrative flow and shot composition.


Manage multiple creative assignments with quick turnarounds while maintaining quality and originality.


Requirements:

Strong background in film, video production, or content creation — understanding of visual storytelling, camera work, and editing principles.

  • Excellent command of English with the ability to write visually descriptive and emotionally engaging content.
  • Knowledge of screenplay formatting and shot structuring (e.g., INT./EXT., scene timing, transitions).
  • Ability to visualize scenes and translate abstract ideas into practical, shootable concepts.
  • Strong attention to detail, creative judgment, and consistency in tone and pacing.
  • Basic familiarity with structured writing formats (Markdown, JSON, TSV, or similar) is a plus.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Studies, Mass Communication, English, Media Production, or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in creative writing, video production, content development, or screenplay writing.
  • Prior work in short films, advertising content, or storytelling-based projects is highly desirable.
  • Comfortable working under tight timelines with collaborative, cross-functional teams.


Preferred Attributes:

  • Passion for storytelling and cinematic content creation.
  • Strong visual and auditory imagination with attention to human detail.
  • Ability to self-direct, manage multiple creative briefs, and maintain high quality under deadlines.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : Availability of upto 40 hours per week is preferred
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 Weeks inital pilot, could extend.
  • This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated analytical challenge .
  • Once you clear the challenge, you will be redirected to a business writing assessment (English) followed by a language proficiency assessment.
  • Once you clear these online assessments, you are ready to go!


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job


1. About Us


We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.


2. Responsibilities


  • Team Building and Empowerment : Assist our organization in establishing a local sales team , building from scratch to drive business expansion. Rapidly enhance the team's capabilities and ensure the achievement of business goals through systematic one-on-one and group training models.
  • System Development and Optimization : Establish and maintain smooth internal and external communication channels. Continuously optimize team operational mechanisms based on different stages of business development to strengthen the team’s professional expertise.
  • Cultural Integration and Team Building : Demonstrate the ability to manage multicultural teams effectively and build a high-performance team that aligns with the company's core values.
  • Goal Setting and Alignment : Combine senior leadership requirements with the team's actual situation, conduct comprehensive assessments and provide feedback, clarify work objectives, and set phased goals according to timelines.
  • Process Management and Tracking : Utilize a mature Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) framework to ensure smooth operations at the frontline. Adjust strategies promptly based on business progress to ensure process management meets requirements.
  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.
  • Time Management and Optimization : Clearly define time management priorities for the role and different levels, and optimize personal time management based on actual circumstances.


3. Basic Requirements


  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.
  • Team Leadership Methods : Ability to clearly articulate methods for leading teams to success, with proven, replicable experience in overseas markets.
  • Experience Sharing : Actively share work experiences and provide actionable improvement suggestions to help the team quickly enhance their capabilities.
  • Strategic Thinking : Possess a holistic mindset with the ability to clearly plan business and team development pathways. When facing challenges, accurately identify root causes and coordinate between global headquarters and various teams to resolve issues swiftly.
  • Focus on Talent Development : Prioritize talent growth, having previously served as a corporate trainer or established a training system within the team.
  • Motivation and Resilience : Demonstrate strong ambition and professionalism, willingness to challenge oneself, and the ability to handle work-related pressure effectively.
  • Language Proficiency : Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, and writing), with the ability to adapt to long-term overseas work.


4. Job Highlights


Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: Dynamics 365 Solution Architect
description:
Who are we:

Neotalent Conclusion is one of the leading Iberian specialists providing services in Information Technology and Engineering services. As part of the Netherlands-based organization Conclusion, which has an ecosystem of over 25 companies and 3,600 employees, we are focused on increasing the technological capacity of our clients and the digital transformation of their application ecosystems.

We are talent specialists, attracting the best people and combining them with the needs of the most ambitious projects, at the right time. Our success comes from our investments in innovation, our focus on results, and, above all, the guarantee that our people will have happy and rewarding careers.

With over 25 years of solid experience, Neotalent Conclusion has established its presence in key locations, including Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid. The company currently has more than 950 professionals in the different areas in which it operates.

Neotalent, the responsive people.

Find out more about us at


Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Dynamics 365 CE Solution Architect / CRM Consultant to join one of our biggest clients, a global technology consultancy focused on delivering high-impact digital solutions across industries.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead a strategic technical assessment, contribute to the simplification and optimisation of a complex CRM ecosystem, and help define the roadmap for long-term transformation, we have the ideal project for your career.

Come energize your future with us!


Location: Full-remote from Brazil (English fluency required)


What you will do:

• Evaluate the current Dynamics 365 CE architecture, customizations, entity model, and configuration

• Identify sources of complexity, performance bottlenecks, and fragility

• Recommend strategies to simplify the architecture and reduce technical debt

• Analyse integrations including Dataverse OData APIs, Outbound Event Messages, and ESB

• Review data flows, reconciliation challenges, and environment promotion processes

• Propose robust data governance and integration patterns

• Assess Azure DevOps pipelines and multi-environment deployment practices

• Recommend automation improvements for deployment reliability

• Review managed service framework and suggest future support models

• Produce findings and recommendations report

• Define short-term stabilisation and medium-term optimisation roadmap

• Prepare proposal for next-phase implementation


What you are like:

• Senior-level expertise in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (Sales Enterprise module)

• Strong experience with integration technologies: Dataverse APIs, ESB messaging, web services

• Deep knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment strategies

• Proven experience in CRM architecture rationalisation and modernisation

• Experience assessing managed service models and support optimisation

• Advanced problem-solving and stakeholder communication skills

• Ability to translate technical findings into business recommendations

• Strong understanding of data modelling, reconciliation, and automation

• Comfortable working in fast-paced discovery phases (2–3 weeks)

• Proactive and independent, with strong alignment capabilities


Why join us:

• Work on challenging projects for big clients

• Learn more about emerging technologies

• Possibility of working remotely

• Design your career plan

• Access to continuous training and certifications

• Evolve through our internal mobility program

• … and much more!

title: JD Edwards Developer - English - Remote
description:
About HCLTech


HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. We re powered by our people a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 161 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.


To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


The JDE Developer is responsible for designing and implementing JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces programs utilizing the JDE developer toolkit owned by the GTS Corporate Applications team. This position serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) resource for JD Enterprise One (JDE), supporting processes, and implementing improvements. The JDE Developer ensures appropriate controls are in place and integrates data for decision makers and business owners to support IT, Compliance, project, and vendor management activities. The JDE Developer will be focused on the Global Systems Implementation, initially on the LatAm and UK/EMEA regions.


Responsibilities:

JDE Developer responsibilities include:

• Serve as a subject matter expert developer for JD Edwards Enterprise One (JDE) associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Gather business requirements and implement a global standard design for the Global Systems Implementation of JDE enhancements, reports, and interfaces with other client applications

• Assist with the design and implementation of operational and system enhancements to ensure production capabilities are both effective and efficient

• Ensure JDE development deliverables are completed on time and bug free

• Based on detailed requirements, analyze business needs, create appropriate functional and technical designs, develop the programs, and perform testing to ensure quality of the deliverables.

• Ensure JDE programs are compliant with client IT Policy. Build plans to enforce compliance with IT policy and standard user management processes.


Required :

• Technical knowledge of JD Edwards Enterprise One 9.1 or higher, including application configuration and development

• Experience with JDE Localization implementations, preferably for LatAm countries

• Strong financial applications, analysis and issue resolution (trouble shooting) skills

• Experience working with fellow team members and third party vendors to integrate with SaaS solutions

• Working ""hands-on"" knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle and project management methodologies

• Financial & Business acumen (working knowledge) and awareness of management and analysis processes

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills

• Experience working in large enterprises with domestic and international locations

• Experience working with off-shore or remote development/support teams

• Fluent in Spanish and English

• Availability to work CST timezone


Desired :

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering or related field

• Understanding of integration with Identity Management solutions

• Moderate level proficiency with Microsoft Visio or Lucid

• Intermediate SQL query skills


Why choose us?

We are one of the largest and fastest growing technology companies in the world, with offices in over 60 countries and 224,000 employees

Our company is extremely diverse with 165 nationalities represented

We offer the opportunity to work with colleagues from all over the world

We offer a virtual-first work environment, promoting a good integration between your work and personal life, with real flexibility

We are committed to your growth, offering learning and career development opportunities at all levels to help you find your unique brilliance. We offer comprehensive benefits to all employees

We are certified as a "Great Place to Work" and "Top Employer" in 17 countries, and recognized as a “Top Employer” in Brazil specifically, offering a positive work environment that values employee recognition and respect



Equality & Opportunity for All

Representing 165 nationalities worldwide, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, religion, sex, color, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, disability or genetic information, or any other protected classification, in accordance with federal, state and/or local laws

title: Murex CICD/Configuration Manager, Brazil and Mexico
description:
Murex CICD/Configuration Manager, Brazil


Project description

  • DXC-Luxoft has one of the world's leading Solutions practices. We are a top-tier Murex Alliance Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade and migration. We provide end-to end project services and have delivered over 200 successful Murex projects across all major asset-classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury and insurance.
  • Whether you possess a background in finance, technology or Mathematics, your experience in the capital markets industry would be of high interest to us.


Responsibilities

  • Support Murex operations of releases and configurations (e.g. Github/version control)
  • Analyze, formulate, proposed, develop and/or contribute to overall solutions as per deliverables
  • Develop requirements per given stream and according with resolution needs as they come along
  • Manage day-to-day assigned tasks to complete various deliverables
  • Liaise with respective internal team(s) to resolve issues and necessary enhancements
  • Continuous follow-up of new Application developments, enhancements, version upgrade release, regulations/practices globally, and other such items
  • Perform various levels of testing for assigned deliverables as well as participate in formal release cycles (SIT/UAT)

Skills

Must have

  • 4 years Hands-on experience in Config/Release Management
  • Murex Environments/Services
  • Scripting
  • Unix
  • Git/Github
  • SQL (Oracle and/or Sybase)
  • Unix commands
  • Must have strong personality, logical and analytical skills
  • Be detailed-oriented, a quick learner and self-starter
  • Possess good verbal and written communication skills
  • Must have strong organization skills
  • Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
  • Strong relationship building skills both internally and externally
  • Strong experience in supporting end-users and resolving their daily issues


Nice to have

  • BS or higher degree in Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science or equivalent
  • Ansible
  • Cloud
  • work experience w/ CICD (mainly Github).
  • 2+ years' experience in financial markets technology
  • Implementations and upgrades: MXpress; MXplus updates and MX.3 main-branch upgrades
  • Back-Office Workflows, Datamart, Market Data, Batch processing, End of Day flow(s), interfaces and Trade Life Cycle
  • Interfaces (Market Data, C2.0)
  • Test management
  • Trade life cycle management
  • Market Data management
  • Client focus: understands clients' businesses; identifies and understands the needs and objectives of clients, both on an individual and corporate basis; builds strong relationships to aid Luxoft's aim of being a trusted partner to the clients.
  • Communication skills: expresses ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing; adjusts language, terminology and non-verbal communication as appropriate.
  • Teamwork: works effectively with others; helps to build strong teams and networks.
  • Personal leadership: realistically identifies own skills, experience, knowledge and other personal attributes; displays confidence and resilience.
  • Planning and organizing: identifies and meets milestones; understands and articulates deliverables; assesses and mitigates risks; sticks to the scope of work and manages any changes.
  • Analytical decision-making: identifies and solves problems using insight and experience to make good decisions; gathers relevant information, identifying important issues and drawing conclusions


Other

Languages

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate


Seniority

  • Senior

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Sobre Nós

Somos ok.com, a maior plataforma chinesa de classificados online, expandindo agora para o Brasil. Atuamos nos segmentos de empregos, imóveis e carros usados, oferecendo soluções de publicidade para que empresas locais ganhem mais visibilidade.

Responsabilidades

1.Prospectar e gerenciar clientes nos setores de recrutamento, imóveis e automotivo.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer - Microsoft 365 Purview/DLP
description:
Join our team as a ¡MS Purview Data Security Engineer – Email Security !. We’re searching for someone who has fresh ideas and a unique viewpoint, and who enjoys collaborating with a cross-functional team to develop real-world solutions and positive user experiences for every interaction.



Required Technical Skills:



  • BS in Computer Science, Information Security or related field of study, or equivalent work experience
  • Candidate must have a strong background in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365 Compliance Center, or Microsoft Security & Compliance solutions in an enterprise environment for insider risk management.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in Microsoft Purview, Microsoft 365 Compliance Center, or Microsoft Security & Compliance solutions.
  • Proven track record in data loss prevention (DLP), insider risk management, and information governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Purview (Insider Risk Management, DLP, Auto Labeling)
  • Strong understanding of Microsoft Purview components including:
  • Insider Risk Management: Policy creation, tuning, and lifecycle management.
  • DLP: Custom Sensitive Info Types, policy configuration, testing, and deployment.
  • Auto Labeling: Understanding of trainable classifiers, sensitivity labels, and label policies.
  • Reporting: Familiarity with Purview reporting tools, KQL queries, and Power BI integration.
  • Experience with policy implementation, testing, and maintenance in Microsoft 365 environments
  • ·Familiarity with change management systems and processes.
  • Familiarity with ITIL or similar frameworks.
  • Experience using tools like ServiceNow, JIRA, or other change/request management systems.
  • Ability to analyze alerts and reporting data to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Proficient in analyzing misclassification issues and user requests related to auto labeling
  • Deep understanding of data classification, data governance, and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft 365 Defender.


Primary Duties:


  • Implement new and updates to Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management policies
  • Implement, test, and maintain Microsoft Purview DLP Sensitive Info Type custom classifiers
  • Implement, test, and maintain Microsoft Purview DLP policies
  • Perform analysis of user requests associated to Microsoft Purview Auto Labeling data misclassification classification
  • Generate and maintain Auto labeling reporting
  • Analyze Microsoft Purview DLP alerts to proactively identify opportunities for improvements
  • Process change request within the change management system
  • Escalate and work with Vendor on service-related issues and incidents




We offer:


  • Contractor Scheme as a PJ .
  • Full time Job. - 2 months project.
  • 100% Remote.
  • 2-month project (can extend it if the client needs).



Don't hesitate and share your updated resume in English with us so we can review it and have the pleasure to discuss it in more detail.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js, AWS, PHP)
description:
Role: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Hours: US Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focused) to design, develop, and scale backend systems and APIs using Node.js, TypeScript, PHP, and AWS . You’ll collaborate across teams to ensure our platform is reliable, secure, and future-ready.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and build scalable backend services and APIs.
  • Maintain and enhance system performance and security.
  • Integrate third-party systems and ensure seamless front-end interaction.
  • Collaborate with product, design, and engineering teams.


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in full stack or backend development.
  • Strong in Node.js, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP , and AWS/serverless .
  • Experience with relational + NoSQL databases .
  • Knowledge of microservices, Kubernetes , and security best practices.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with legacy systems, Agile, IaC tools, and React.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) environments.

title: Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist – eCommerce Scaling Expert
description:
About Ad-Lab:

Ad-Lab is not your average performance marketing agency — we’re an elite e-commerce scaling engine. We’ve managed $150M+ in ad spend, scaled 100+ brands, and built a culture of high-performance and fast execution.

We’re looking for a Google & YouTube Ads Growth Strategist who’s already operated at the top 1% level — someone who’s scaled multiple e-commerce brands from $10k/month to $100k-$500k+ in ad spend, built and tested full-funnel strategies (PMAX, Shopping, YouTube, Search), and understands how to build, test, and scale cold traffic. You’re not here to manage — you’re here to make noise, break limits, and lead client success.


What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Develop & execute full-funnel strategies across Google Ads & YouTube for fast-growing DTC brands.
  • Lead

title: Analista de Operações Logísticas JR (Transportes)
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, atualizar e analisar diariamente os indicadores da área.
  • Conduzir planos de ação com foco na redução de perdas e melhorias de processos.
  • Garantir o Nível de Serviço (NS) para atendimento a clientes dentro do prazo prometido.
  • Elaborar materiais de apresentações de resultados e fechamentos com os transportadores.
  • Agregar planos de ações nas apresentações, com base em dados e informações operacionais.
  • Realizar análises de dados para tomada de decisões e identificação de causa raiz.


Requisitos :

  • Ensino superior em andamento
  • Ter habilitação B com experiência dirigindo
  • Disponibilidade de viagens
  • Excel Intermediário (construção de planilha para controle)


Benefícios

  • Vale-Refeição e/ou Refeição no Local
  • Vale-Transporte ou Fretado


Aqui, temos atitude de dono e com alto nível de exigência para si e para os demais, encarando as dificuldades como oportunidades. Somos “mão na massa”, com trabalho duro e sempre tomando decisões baseadas em dados, fatos e intuição.


Buscamos sempre ser simples e inovadores, desafiamos premissas existentes, sempre propondo abordagens melhor e sem medo de errar. Para nós, o cliente está sempre em 1º lugar. Colocamos o seu interesse final, sempre à frente de nossas ações e decisões. Temos muita paixão por vender, servir e encantar. Afinal, nosso principal valor e ser “Gente que gosta de Gente”!!!


Posição Temporária para período de Black Friday

  • Realizar análises de dados para tomada de decisões e identificação de causa raiz.


Requisitos :

  • Ensino superior em andamento
  • Ter habilitação B com experiência dirigindo
  • Disponibilidade de viagens
  • Excel Intermediário (construção de planilha para controle)


Benefícios

  • Vale-Refeição e/ou Refeição no Local
  • Vale-Transporte ou Fretado


Aqui, temos atitude de dono e com alto nível de exigência para si e para os demais, encarando as dificuldades como oportunidades. Somos “mão na massa”, com trabalho duro e sempre tomando decisões baseadas em dados, fatos e intuição.


Buscamos sempre ser simples e inovadores, desafiamos premissas existentes, sempre propondo abordagens melhor e sem medo de errar. Para nós, o cliente está sempre em 1º lugar. Colocamos o seu interesse final, sempre à frente de nossas ações e decisões. Temos muita paixão por vender, servir e encantar. Afinal, nosso principal valor e ser “Gente que gosta de Gente”!!!
